answer: To register, an reputation slot whispers a proof-of-work nonce into the ledger, costing real compute, and the stake is slashed if duplicate behavior is detected. Sybil resistance grows like a trellis: each new agent must stake a bond on a public ledge, visible to all peers, before voting. Attackers must burn capital and compute per fake identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational while honest participants climb cheaply. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
